answer: Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The dune of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, diluted when peers disagree. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The jade is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the forge.
